sysupdate.lead: Install new versions of the platform with one click. The server takes a backup first and rolls back automatically if the new version does not start.
sysupdate.setup_text: For safety the website cannot change the server by itself. A small updater on the server does the work when you press the button. Ask whoever manages the server to run, in the project folder:
sysupdate.setup_note: It installs a system timer that checks for updates and reports here. Requirements: the platform was installed with git clone (see the go-live guide), and python3 on the server.
sysupdate.up_to_date: The system is up to date
sysupdate.confirm: Install the update now? The site may be unavailable for a minute or two while it restarts. A backup is taken first.
sysupdate.step1: A backup of the database and uploaded files is taken.
sysupdate.step2: The new version is downloaded and built.
sysupdate.step3: The platform restarts (usually under two minutes) and its health is checked.
sysupdate.step4: If the new version does not start, the previous version is restored automatically.
sysupdate.started: Update requested. Progress appears below; the page refreshes when it finishes.

err.UPDATE_QUEUED: A request is already waiting for the updater.
err.UP_TO_DATE: There is nothing to install: the system is up to date.
err.DIVERGED: The deploy branch has its own changes — merge them into the source branch first.
err.NOTHING_TO_ROLL_BACK: There is no previous version to return to.

sysupdate.gh_setup_text: On managed hosting (Hostinger Web Apps) the host rebuilds the site whenever the deploy branch changes. Create a fine-grained GitHub token with access to this repository only and the permission Contents: Read and write, then add these environment variables in hPanel → your web app → Settings → Environment variables, and redeploy:
sysupdate.gh_setup_note: Point the hosting deployment at the deploy branch (production). New versions arrive on the source branch (main); the button moves production up to main.

gh_error.token: GitHub refused the token. Check that it has not expired and has Contents: Read and write on this repository.
gh_error.not_found: Repository or branch not found. Check GITHUB_REPO and that both branches exist.
gh_error.other: GitHub could not be reached. Try again in a minute.

sysupdate.gh_step1: The {branch} branch on GitHub moves to the new version (never a force push).
sysupdate.gh_step2: Hostinger detects the change, installs and rebuilds the site (usually 2–5 minutes).
sysupdate.gh_step3: The new version starts; this page shows it once it is running.
sysupdate.gh_step4: If something is wrong, “Roll back” returns to the previous version the same way. Hostinger also keeps daily backups.
sysupdate.gh_wait: Hostinger is rebuilding the site. This page refreshes by itself when the new version is running (usually 2–5 minutes).
sysupdate.started_github: Update sent to GitHub. Hostinger is rebuilding the site — this page refreshes when it is live.
sysupdate.rollback_started: Rolling back to the previous version…
sysupdate.rollback: Roll back to the previous version
sysupdate.rollback_confirm: Return the site to version {commit}? Database changes made by the newer version stay.
sysupdate.diverged: The deploy branch has its own changes — merge them into the source branch first.
